question: How big is the difference in performance between proposed model and baselines?

answer.free_form_answer:
Metric difference between Aloha and best baseline score:
Hits@1/20: +0.061 (0.3642 vs 0.3032)
MRR: +0.0572(0.5114 vs 0.4542)
F1: -0.0484 (0.3901 vs 0.4385)
BLEU: +0.0474 (0.2867 vs 0.2393)
evidence: Table TABREF44 shows average results of our automatic and human evaluations. Table TABREF45 shows average Hits@1/20 scores by evaluation character. See Appendix F for detailed evaluation results. title: Follow Alice into the Rabbit Hole: Giving Dialogue Agents Understanding of Human Level Attributes.
answer_short: ALOHA outperforms baselines significantly in Hits@n/N accuracy and other metrics for retrieving correct responses of diverse characters.
answer_rationale: The document states in Text 88 that ALOHA achieves a significant improvement over baseline open-domain chatbot models in Hits@n/N accuracy and other metrics for retrieving correct responses of five diverse characters. Additionally, Text 90 confirms a noticeable performance improvement between ALOHA and the Uniform Model (a baseline) across all five evaluation characters, indicating that ALOHA's use of HLAs enhances performance compared to baselines.
